source.text: Closed-form centre temperature of the series solution (film, cladding wall, gap, fuel), mesh 100/20. The observed value is the first fuel cell centre; the tolerance is 5 * rise / N^2 rounded up.
source.check: Second method: the same series solved in Python for the table in oracles/closed-form-table.json, and the solver's own closedForm checks in FEED's test suite (tests/solverEndToEnd.test.ts) reproduce it within the refinement bound.
